verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a backend platform like Firebase, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that an external consumer can subscribe to. Cloud Functions event triggers (firebase-docs-7, firebase-docs-29) run the developer's own code in response to events, and realtime listeners (firebase-docs-35) are SDK-side sync; both are developer building blocks or adjacent features rather than a webhook subscription capability, so they earn no credit.
